_comment: Iteration 7 execution policy for the local demo environment. Configurable, not hard-coded safety rules. Action types use the RemediationPlan vocabulary (AdjustResourceLimit = adjust_resource_limit, ...). allowed_executors: "approvers" (= SLACK_APPROVERS) or a list of Slack user IDs.

verification._settle: Settled = the changed component ready on settle_stable_samples consecutive samples (poll interval apart), at most settle_max_seconds. 120 s from the Demo A calibration: under near-capacity load recovery took ~80 s (docs/validation/iter-07-demo-a-calibration.md).
